edges.reason: setDelay writes the delay_ parameter into the delay state variable.
setPendingAdmin writes pendingAdmin_ into the pendingAdmin state variable.
eta is hashed to compute txHash in queue/cancel/executeTransaction.
target is hashed to compute txHash.
signature is hashed into the function selector used to build callData.
data is packed into callData for the external call.
callData is the calldata supplied to the low-level call.
target is the recipient of the low-level call.
value is the ETH amount forwarded in the low-level call.
The success flag is assigned from the result of the low-level call.
returnData is assigned from the bytes returned by the low-level call.
executeTransaction performs an external call with value after clearing its queued flag, enabling reentrancy.
The arbitrary external call can re-enter executeTransaction or other timelock functions.
executeTransaction calls getBlockTimestamp for eta window validation.
queueTransaction calls getBlockTimestamp to validate eta against delay.
block.timestamp is returned by getBlockTimestamp and drives timelock enforcement.
queueTransaction authorization/eta check depends on the miner-influenced block.timestamp.
executeTransaction validity window depends on block.timestamp.
setDelay requires msg.sender to be the contract itself.
acceptAdmin requires msg.sender to equal pendingAdmin.
setPendingAdmin restricts callers to self once admin_initialized is true.
queueTransaction requires msg.sender to be admin.
cancelTransaction requires msg.sender to be admin.
executeTransaction requires msg.sender to be admin.
constructor and acceptAdmin assign msg.sender to the admin state variable.
admin_initialized gates whether timelock and queued-transaction checks are enforced.
executeTransaction reads queuedTransactions[txHash] to validate and clear the queued entry.
queueTransaction writes true to queuedTransactions[txHash].
cancelTransaction writes false to queuedTransactions[txHash].
constructor initializes delay with MINIMUM_DELAY.
GRACE_PERIOD bounds the allowed execution window in executeTransaction.
setDelay bound-check using MINIMUM_DELAY/MAXIMUM_DELAY guards the delay arithmetic.
constructor assigns msg.sender as the initial admin.
constructor sets the initial delay value.
constructor sets admin_initialized to false.

normalization_plan.reason: delay_ is only used to assign the delay state variable inside setDelay.
pendingAdmin_ is only used to assign the pendingAdmin state variable inside setPendingAdmin.
target directly determines the destination of the low-level external call.
value directly determines the ETH amount forwarded in the low-level external call.
signature is encoded into the calldata of the low-level external call.
data is packed into the calldata of the low-level external call.
eta drives the timelock validity checks inside executeTransaction.
txHash is the transaction identifier validated and cleared inside executeTransaction.
callData is the encoded payload supplied to the low-level call.
success holds the boolean outcome of the low-level call.
returnData holds the bytes returned by the call and is returned by executeTransaction.
